en.headline: sogeisetsu: 10 commits across 3 repos, issue #8 comment
en.summary: On 2026-10-22 `sogeisetsu` recorded **10 own commits** across three repositories, plus 3 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` there were 6 commits: an MV3 skeleton with page and selection translation was followed by dropping selection translation to keep page translation only, adding `AGENTS.md`, enabling `checkJs` type checking via JSDoc, resetting page state between runs with smoke tests and required-field validation, and a DOM smoke test for two-round restore that also fixed doc drift. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the 3 own commits added a free-leg `opencode-go-minimax` provider ordered before `longcat`, refreshed the codemap baseline to `9cc6516`, and corrected the activity-card 422 note while filling in codemap and test-render table docs. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` one docs commit added the `openchamber-storage` knowledge category covering pasted-image file vs database storage and the no-shrink delete and `VACUUM` flow. The user commented on issue `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#8` ([ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败), which has 5 comments, opening or closing 1 issue overall. Separately, `openchamber/openchamber#5293` was closed by `btriapitsyn`. There were no pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：三个仓库共 10 次提交，评论 issue #8
zh.summary: 2026-10-22，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库中记录了 **10 次本人提交**，另有 3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 有 6 次提交：先搭建 MV3 骨架并支持整页与划词翻译，随后去掉划词翻译只保留整页翻译，添加 `AGENTS.md` 说明仓库约束，通过 JSDoc 启用 `checkJs` 类型检查，在翻译运行之间重置页面状态并补充冒烟测试与必填校验，最后为两轮恢复添加 DOM 冒烟测试并修正文档偏差。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 3 次本人提交新增免费线路 `opencode-go-minimax`（排在 `longcat` 之前），把 codemap 基线刷新到 `9cc6516`，并修正活动卡片 422 的“未修”误记、补齐 codemap 与 test-render 的表格说明。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 1 次文档提交，新增 `openchamber-storage` 知识类别，涵盖粘贴图片存文件还是落库、删除不缩与 `VACUUM` 流程。用户评论了 issue `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#8`（[ai-failure] AI 叙述生成失败），该 issue 共有 5 条评论，整体新开或关闭 1 个 issue。另外，`openchamber/openchamber#5293` 已由 `btriapitsyn` 关闭。当天没有拉取请求、评审、发布或讨论活动。
